summary: IAMGOLD Corporation filed a Form 6-K on October 5, 2026, furnishing a news release that solely announces the timing of its third quarter 2026 operating and financial results. The release states results will be published after market hours on Thursday, November 5, 2026, with a management conference call on Friday, November 6, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time. It also provides dial-in numbers, a webcast link, pre-registration instructions, and replay details. No transaction, strategic action, shareholder matter, or change in control is disclosed; this is a routine results-scheduling notice.
